title: Om drone
detail: A slow, warm drone tuned to 136.1 Hz, the pitch traditionally linked with Om.

title: Tanpura drone
detail: A tanpura-style Sa–Pa drone, like the steady backdrop of Indian classical music.

title: Binaural · alpha-style
detail: Two slightly different tones (200 Hz and 210 Hz), one in each ear, over soft noise.

title: Binaural · theta-style
detail: Two slightly different tones (180 Hz and 186 Hz), one in each ear, over soft noise.
